duel.label: 30 人宗教對決

native.label: 自然河谷
native.note: Original separated origins, neutral villages, development and normal opponent AI. Credible cross-town faith conversions may be rare until genuine connections form.

duel.comment: Paired experimental RNG, original controlled experiment intended for reproducible mechanism demonstration; can trigger a post-day-100 conversion cascade.

native.comment: Normal world religion RNG. Conservative evidence gain, but not yet balanced or verified against natural map contact gaps.

warnings: The accepted voluntary conversion principle is design authority; this particular attraction gain/probability is experimental.
A correct counter may not defeat the rival in an unconnected natural map.
Old saved worlds retain their old mode and no forced upgrade.
